equivalent_not_counted.argument: Not countable under the case schema. The distinguishing input is a directory with no loadable mime.cache; there the oracle always answers (it reads the magic/globs2 text files: e.g. globs2 '50:text/x-text:*.txt' with name x.txt -> text/x-text 0), so a case's label can never be UNSUPPORTED (the schema reserves that for an oracle crash or hang) and a text-mode case would be a false kill of the correct tool. The refusal is C1's declared named limit ('cache mode only'), not a rule a case can measure.
